Roles and permissions

Intake volunteers log receipts at their own site. Pantry leads post distributions and transfers. Operations staff see stock and low-stock alerts across sites.

Build prompt

Build “Food Pantry & Supply Inventory Tracker” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Record receipts and distributions in the same units. Pick eligible lots with the earliest expiry first, exclude expired lots and reconcile transfers between sites. Intake volunteers log receipts at their own site. Pantry leads post distributions and transfers. Operations staff see stock and low-stock alerts across sites. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

Two eligible lots have 8 and 10 units. Distributing 12 uses 8 from the earlier lot and 4 from the later one. Six remain and one alert appears at a threshold of 7.
